Name: CS_AA_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Anti-aliasing settings for each level of the Antialiasing Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 1.

Fields.Name: Anti-Aliasing Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns anti-aliasing on for this level. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: Force FXAA
Fields.Description: On: the configured anti-aliasing mode is replaced with plain FXAA (no temporal anti-aliasing). Retail: on for Low and Medium.
